description:
LANDED 343f3a134 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Cold review with
prototype (approve-with-fixes, folded), adversarial refutation (FIX-THEN-
MERGE, folded), then rebased onto fz-kdt.183 and fz-kdt.198.

THE CHANGE: a @spec instantiation's witness is the RAW ARGUMENT, and arrow-
set coverage reads a polymorphic clause's domain at `any`. arrow_match.rs
instantiate_match(params, result, bounds, args) walks (params, args) once;
the pattern-derived witness machinery (overlapping_witnesses, match_witness)
is deleted. contract.rs arrow_set_covers reads each clause's
input_domain_row at `any` so a var-carrying domain participates in coverage
instead of being skipped -- `@spec unwrap({:ok, a}) :: a` +
`@spec unwrap({:err, a}) :: a` applied to `{:ok, int} | {:err, int}` no
longer dies spec/violation. D1 folded; collect_ambiguous_tuple_field_vars
carries the empty-list veto per position.

WHAT IT PROVED: fixtures2/behavior/spec_polymorphic_clause_set_coverage.fz
prints 7 on interp, run and build; it dies spec/violation on all three with
192's calculator change and the base coverage check, and prints 7 again with
the coverage fix. Contract probes C1 and C3 fail in that ablation and pass
here. 52 pinned verdicts in arrow_match.rs + 4 in contract_test.rs. The
witness pins: x5 (a branded argument is now accepted at a ground field, the
198 law reaching the gate through the raw argument), x5b (a bare int rejected
at a Meters(int) field, 192's gate flipping what 198 alone left Known), x2 /
x2b (a var-carrying union member is ignored and the verdict is Known -- a non-
ground observation manufacturing groundness, fz-kdt.197).

MEASURED (603 shared fixtures, against 2ba78b195; the 604th is 192's own
fixture): interp 0 movers, run 0 movers; canon 2 files differ (00420 and
behavior/enum_take_drop_split) and are byte-identical once two same-key
duplicate executables are aliased (x58/x59, both Enum.reverse_list/1[fp[L]
list(int)] need=Value; 11 of that artifact's 204 executables sit in such
groups at base and here -- fz-kdt.182's mechanism); executables 5465 and
return-any 605 unchanged; FIFO/LIFO divergence 2 at base and here (no
schedule dependence added). match_arrow 38,641 -> 38,785 calls; 21 shared
callsite rows change verdict, 3 Invalid -> Known (a union-of-arrows arg with
a free var no longer restated) and 18 Known -> Underconstrained (8 are
List.reduce_while_step/3 rows where base pinned c = [] from the empty list
and published it as a runtime fact, now honestly free; 10 are fz-f98.16's D3
tuple-field veto, a precision loss). collect_match_subst visits 278,857 ->
147,653 (-47.0%). FunctionContract::apply fallback not-covered 505 -> 497,
covered 6 -> 6.

FOLDED FROM REFUTATION: the public_trace ratchet reason named rows this
fixture does not have; corrected to the measured falls. Four commit-message
numbers corrected (1,801 shared rows not 1,742; per-fixture band 0.0% to
-53.5%; D3 widened 1 -> 4 not 8; 8 failures at base). the_reproducer_reduces_
with_a_binary_reducer folded into r11_reduce_with_a_binary_reducer (one fact,
one test).

FOLDED FROM THE REBASE: the three enum_take_drop_split ratchet blocks
re-measured on the stacked tree (activations 259 -> 256, callsites 434/450/16
-> 430/445/15, shifts 25/77 held from 183, analyze 900/16/2423 ->
889/15/2412), each pin stating both 183's and 192's cause. X5/X5B rewritten
as present-tense facts of the post-198 lattice; every inverted-order sentence
192 had written about mint_brand deleted.

RESIDUES, EACH OWNED: fz-kdt.184 re-cuts on this (the polarity split; fix 2
struck, R20 is Underconstrained here); fz-kdt.120 re-cuts on 184 and deletes
the empty-list cleaner (the real fix for the 18 K->U rows); fz-kdt.197 (the
non-ground Known); fz-kdt.198 (the brand lattice, landed); fz-kdt.182 (the
same-key duplicates); fz-kdt.201 / fz-kdt.207 (the @spec return side and
callable-argument domain, both still unchecked). Pre-existing:
00424_protocol_no_impl.fz panics at artifact.rs:155 (fz-kdt.149).

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded commit (marker COORD192-1788443451): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, doctests clean, lib 1699 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored, fixture matrix single-threaded 506 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored (503 + three doors for the new fixture); PR #110 CI green on the base 2ba78b195.

comments.text: PROMOTED TO THE HEAD OF THE CONFLUENCE CHAIN by the fz-kdt.184 cold review (2026-09-03): land this FIRST (192 -> 184 -> 124 -> 183 -> 120). Scope confirmed by measurement: 184's prototype pays for this defect with instantiate_match(params, result, bounds, witnesses, args) -- two full walks per position of which position.upper and observed.lower are discarded and the args walk's MatchWitness is dropped without a `let _`; 120's prototype pays with open_vars(params, args). With witnesses as OBSERVATIONS (the argument, narrowed by the pattern's ground parts, never a restated pattern) one walk over (params, args) yields lower bounds, upper bounds and openness. Reproducer stays: match_arrow([[a], b, (a,b)->b], b, {}, [[int], int, (binary,int)->int]) hands the third witness back as (a,int)->int. Acceptance: 0 corpus movers (interp/run/canon), the R-series and A-series verdict tables from the 184 review unchanged at HEAD (they are the pins), and a test that the witness of a pattern position carrying an unbound variable is the raw argument.

fz-kdt.198 landed (4c3fa4c63); this ticket now rebases onto it. Measured pin flips (refuter, on 198's calculator): x5_branded_argument_at_a_ground_pattern_field -- display "int | Meters" -> "Meters(int)"; is_subtype(branded, int) TRUE; is_subtype(int, branded) FALSE; the `t.brand_of("Meters")` line and its assertion must be DELETED (Types::brand_of no longer exists; there is no bare-tag constructor); verdict Invalid -> accepting (198's match_arrow answers Known params=["{int, binary}"] result="binary"). x5b_bare_argument_at_a_branded_pattern_field: 198 ALONE does not flip it (still Known params=["{Meters(int), binary}"] -- HEAD's overlapping_witnesses intersects); the verdict flips to rejecting only by this ticket's raw-argument gate, so X5B is YOUR red-first signal, not a consequence of 198. Rewrite both pins' comments as facts of the lattice, not as "moves when 198 lands".

title: A witness is the raw argument: overlapping_witnesses and match_witness go, the structural gate compares what the call supplied, and arrow-set coverage reads polymorphic clause domains at any
